title: Naturally Crisp Filipino Tofu Leche Flan
description: A fermented and crisp Filipino dessert featuring Thai bird chili, soffritto base, and vegetarian friendly ingredients, perfect for a date night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, combine the silken tofu, granulated sugar, Thai bird chili, and soffritto base, and blend until smooth.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the coconut cream, eggs, vanilla extract, and salt.
Add the coconut cream mixture to the blender and blend until well combined.
Pour the mixture into 6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides.
Bake for 45 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled and set.
Just before serving, sprinkle a pinch of sugar on top of each ramekin and caramelize with a kitchen torch.
